% fancyvrb's \UseVerb under a frame set for every verbatim block: a block
% that sets frame=none has no border, and the saved text after it is
% inline, as in the PDF. Saved text with a text color, a fill color, and
% a rule color colors neither the block nor its frame.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor,fancyvrb}
\fvset{frame=single}
\SaveVerb{v}|uvf-text_a|
\begin{document}
Before the block.
\begin{Verbatim}[frame=none]
uvf-block
\end{Verbatim}
Text \UseVerb{v} more.

Red \UseVerb[formatcom=\color{red}]{v} end.

Filled \UseVerb[fillcolor=\color{yellow},rulecolor=\color{blue}]{v} end.
\end{document}
